title: Sample Industrial Venture I JVA (excerpt)
summary: Sample Industrial Venture I · Joint venture · effective March 31, 2022

evidence.quote: This Agreement governs Sample Industrial Venture I, a joint venture between the Investor Member and the Sponsor Member.
The Investor Member is Example Pension Fund.
The Investor Member is a pension fund.
Total equity commitments are $80,000,000.
The Sponsor Member commits 10% of the total equity and the Investor Member the balance.
The Sponsor Member is paid an asset management fee of 0.75% per year of invested equity.
The Sponsor Member is paid an asset management fee of 0.75% per year of invested equity.
The asset management fee is paid to the Sponsor Member, the sponsor.
Property management is carried out by the Sponsor Member, the sponsor, for a fee of 5% of each property's revenue.
Construction management is carried out by the Sponsor Member, the sponsor, for a fee of 1.5% of construction spending.
Distributions are made first to the parties in proportion to their capital until each has received a preferred return of 8% per year and the return of its capital.
There is no catch-up to the Sponsor Member: the catch-up is 0%.
Distributions are then split 80% to the capital and 20% to the Sponsor Member as promote until the Investor Member has achieved a 14% IRR, and thereafter 70% and 30%.
Each split applies only to the distributions made within its tier, and no split applies retroactively to distributions already made.
The investment period is 3 years from March 31, 2022.
The term is 7 years from March 31, 2022.
The term may be extended 2 times with the Investor Member's consent.
Each extension is for 1 year.
This Agreement is dated March 31, 2022, and its term runs from that date.
Either member may start the buy-sell procedure on or after March 31, 2025.
Every property is to be sold by March 31, 2031, the outside sale date.
The Sponsor Member targets a net internal rate of return to the Investor Member of 13%. The target is not a promise.
The Sponsor Member targets a net equity multiple to the Investor Member of 1.7x.
The Sponsor Member targets an average cash yield to the Investor Member of 6% per year on the capital called.
Leverage on any one property: borrowing secured by any one property may not exceed 80% of the property's value.
Permitted property types: industrial and flex properties only.

limits.label: Major decisions
limits.limit: A sale or refinancing of a property needs the Investor Member's consent
